title: habenella oerstedii
intro: Habenella oerstedii, commonly known as the 'Cordia', is a plant species native to Central America and Mexico, characterized by its distinctive flowers and leaves. The health benefits of Habenella oerstedii include its potential in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to relax the muscles, reduce pain and anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of Habenella oerstedii include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
